scope: Retire obsolete reader APIs and duplicated validation setup after all production readers migrated to explicit decode context and routed tasks. No SQL behavior or finding disposition change.
migrated_consumers: IndexJoinLookupExec directly consumes the existing routed row result, discarding the same unused request positions as its former wrapper.
Virtual/default/projection tests use the live routed builder/drain and preserve legacy decode flags.
Point tests use the mapped constructor with Stored offsets; lazy batch decoding, missing rows and malformed bytes retain their assertions.
Table scan tests use new_with_context with the same legacy defaults.
test_consolidation: Three partition-reader tests now run their same three SQL/result/request-policy cases against one fixture, clearing request captures between queries.

The standalone sorted integer-response test is folded into the integer/common-handle projection matrix. Sorted inputs, reversed completion and exact values remain checked; integer projections now also cover reordered and empty columns.
Three fewer registered test functions; no meaningful behavioral assertion discarded. No permanent test-count or source-shape gate introduced.
retained: Foreign-key scan_rows/scan_rows_with_handles wrappers with production consumers.
Row/chunk identity, dirty fallback, stream cleanup, request-policy and point-read regressions.
Go correctness contracts, original source inventories and historical receipts.
Maintained live runners and their path-safety, authentication and protobuf-sync tests.

commands.command: cargo test --locked -p tidb-executor --lib -- partition_reader table_reader common_reader reader_task_ remote_scan::tests:: access_path::tests:: kv_table::table_scan::remote_cursor_tests:: index_merge point_get --test-threads=1

not_run: Live multi-node TiKV or repeated wire suite; cleanup uses the unchanged reader implementations
Compile-time or benchmark comparison; no measured speedup claimed
validation.publication: Actual locked-build hook, fresh pre-push build, remote SHA and Cloud checkpoint are recorded in /workspace/.cloud-setup/reader-cleanup-batch/final-handoff.json.
